description: Typed connector file family: put, get, list, remove, copy_into_table, copy_into_location and copy_files. PUT/GET local_path is an absolute filesystem path within saved locations, which protects uploads and downloads. stage_location is an unquoted @stage/path (named, table or user stage); COPY INTO also accepts s3://, s3china://, s3gov://, gcs:// and azure:// cloud URLs. COPY FILES uses named stages (internal/external) or a query of file URLs, with a named-stage target. options accepts vendor SQL keyword names case insensitively, without a COPY name allowlist: string/boolean/numeric literals, lists, nested option objects, or explicit {sql: expression} for identifiers, INCLUDE_METADATA mappings and other SQL expressions. PUT supports PARALLEL, AUTO_COMPRESS, SOURCE_COMPRESSION, OVERWRITE; GET supports PARALLEL and PATTERN; LIST/REMOVE support PATTERN. COPY INTO table accepts table, columns and an optional transformation query; COPY INTO location accepts table or query and partition_by; COPY FILES accepts source_location or query. Both COPY INTO forms require output_tsv_path for all result rows including validation data. Vendor RBAC decides every operation, with no extra write or delete prompt. Returns job_id/status queued; completion is separate.
embedding_description: Upload local files to Snowflake stages, download staged files to a workspace directory, list and remove files, load tables and unload query results with COPY INTO, or copy files between stages. Use for contained file transfers and bulk data movement with reads, writes and deletes governed by the registered Snowflake role.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job_id/status. Completion includes operation and vendor query_id. PUT returns results per matched local file with rows, row_count and vendor_success; GET returns rows plus final paths; LIST/REMOVE/COPY FILES return complete metadata rows. Both COPY INTO forms return path, columns, row_count, with all rows in TSV, never inline.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued does not mean transferred or loaded. Inspect per-file vendor status: UPLOADED/DOWNLOADED/LOADED report success; SKIPPED means not overwritten; ERROR and partial load statuses remain visible even when the job completed. Relay COPY TSV path/count; never inline its business data. A failed transfer, REMOVE or COPY can leave partial effects; do not claim rollback or silently retry. GET replaces matching local destination entries; COPY FILES overwrites matching stage files.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Perform Snowflake stage transfer and COPY commands using the registered account and role.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.invalid_params: invalid operation/options, missing required path/table, missing upload, missing GET directory or missing COPY output parent. snowflake.export_path_refused: the path must be absolute, have the required suffix where specified, and lie under a saved path address, the session folder or solet home, outside the installation tree. Input files must already exist.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use an existing absolute workspace path under a saved location for PUT/GET. Use an absolute contained .tsv path for COPY INTO results. Read vendor file statuses or the result TSV before retrying a mutation; a failure may have partial effects. Correct a staged file with PUT OVERWRITE=true, retire it with REMOVE, and recreate with PUT. Vendor grants are the Snowflake authorization boundary.
